title: File:Boston Marathon 2019 Women's pack.agr.jpg
claims: The file shows the chasing group of women at Walnut Street just past mile 19 of the 2019 Boston Marathon.
The file description names Edna Kiplagat and Jordan Hasay in the group, with eventual winner Worknesh Degefa already ahead.
The uploader and author is ArnoldReinhold, credited as own work.
